answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 225 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is logged in the whisper receipt and checked against the haven nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the violet audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
